cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(nclgl)

find_package(OpenGL REQUIRED)
find_package (glfw3 REQUIRED)

include_directories(${GLFW_INCLUDE_DIRS})
include_directories(/home/gdr/Documents/emsdk/emscripten/1.38.11/system/include/.)

add_definitions(-DUSE_DESKTOP=1)

add_executable(nclgl ./src/nclgl/main.cpp)

target_link_libraries(nclgl ${OPENGL_LIBRARIES} ${GLFW3_LIBRARY} glfw)
